products.name: Luxe Gold Silk Kaftan
products.label: New Arrival
products.careInstructions: Hand wash cold or dry clean. Hang dry away from direct sunlight.

products.name: Adire Swirl Two-Piece Set
products.shortDescription: Artisanal hand-dyed Adire swirl print blouse with coordinating wide-leg trousers.
products.description: Crafted in breathable cotton poplin, this statement two-piece set showcases an energetic swirl motif in rich emerald green, cobalt blue, and crisp ivory. Featuring an airy relaxed-fit top with side ties and fluid high-waisted wide-leg trousers, it transitions seamlessly from daytime social events to festive evening gatherings.
products.label: New Arrival

specifications.Trouser Waist: Comfort elasticated waist with wide-leg sweep

products.careInstructions: Hand wash cold with mild detergent or dry clean. Hang dry away from direct sunlight. Warm iron on reverse.

products.name: Tri-Color Batik Tiered Maxi Skirt
products.shortDescription: Tiered full-length maxi skirt featuring contrasting graphic batik block panels.
products.description: A celebration of modern African craftsmanship, this tiered skirt pairs three contrasting block prints in botanical green, deep vermilion red, and dramatic onyx black. The elasticated smocked waistband ensures all-day comfort and a flattering drape that moves gracefully with every step.
products.label: Staff Pick
products.careInstructions: Gentle machine wash cold. Do not bleach. Line dry in shade. Warm iron.

products.name: Heritage Linear Striped Buba & Trouser Set
products.shortDescription: Contemporary striped tunic top paired with matching straight-cut trousers.
products.description: Drawing inspiration from traditional loom woven aesthetics, this two-piece set features dynamic vertical and horizontal bands of vivid azure, crimson red, teal, and jet black. Designed for the modern woman who values distinction and effortless cultural elegance.
products.label: Bestseller

specifications.Neckline: Split V-neck with woven accent border

products.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended or gentle hand wash.

products.name: Riviera Canvas & Vegan Leather Bucket Bag
products.shortDescription: Refined two-tone canvas bucket bag with cognac saddle leather trim and gold drawstring.
products.description: The quintessential warm-weather and everyday companion. Crafted from durable woven oat canvas accented with rich cognac vegan leather and brushed champagne gold hardware. Includes both a comfortable top handle and an adjustable crossbody strap.
products.label: The Edit

specifications.Interior: Suedette lining with zippered slip pocket
specifications.Closure: Braided leather drawstring cinch with gold grommets

products.careInstructions: Spot clean canvas with a damp cloth. Wipe leather trim with a dry soft cloth.

products.name: Croc-Embossed Executive Satchel
products.shortDescription: High-shine structured handbag with signature buckle strap detailing and detachable shoulder strap.
products.description: Exude poise and polished sophistication. Made from premium crocodile-embossed vegan leather with a lustrous patent finish, dual rolled top handles, and sleek metal bar strap accents. Spacious enough for your daily essentials, tablet, and cosmetics.
products.label: Bestseller

specifications.Hardware: Protective metal feet and reinforced buckle clasps
specifications.Compartments: Triple compartment with central zip divider

products.careInstructions: Wipe clean with a soft microfiber cloth. Store in dustbag when not in use.

products.name: Verona Structured Dome Handbag Set
products.shortDescription: Dual-piece set with a pebbled dome satchel and coordinating crescent coin pouch.
products.description: A versatile 2-in-1 pairing featuring our signature pebbled leatherette dome handbag with sleek angled strap hardware and an accompanying half-moon organizer pouch. Perfect for effortless transition from boardroom meetings to weekend dinners.
products.label: New Arrival
products.careInstructions: Avoid direct heat. Store with stuffing to retain structured silhouette.

products.name: Artisan Textured Silver Bangle
products.shortDescription: Twisted cable cuff bracelet in polished sterling silver finish.
products.description: A timeless wrist piece with intricate ribbed cable detailing and smooth spherical endcaps. Stacks effortlessly with watches or shines on its own as a refined signature touch for both traditional and western attire.
products.label: Staff Pick
products.careInstructions: Keep away from perfume and moisture. Store in a soft pouch.

products.name: Croc-Embossed Monogram Clutch
products.shortDescription: Compact ivory croc-embossed crossbody clutch with sleek metallic emblem.
products.description: Designed to carry your evening essentials with understated elegance. Features an embossed crocodile texture, detachable link chain strap, and secure magnetic flap closure.
products.label: The Edit
products.careInstructions: Wipe gently with dry cotton cloth.

products.name: Radiant Glow Hydrating Primer Mist
products.shortDescription: Dewy setting spray and prep mist infused with rosewater and hyaluronic acid.
products.description: Prep, hydrate, and lock in your look with this ultra-fine illuminating mist. Enriched with botanical extracts and niacinamide, it leaves skin with a natural healthy glow suitable for tropical and temperate climates alike.
products.label: New Arrival

specifications.Key Ingredients: Hyaluronic Acid, Rose Damascena Water, Aloe Vera Extract

products.careInstructions: Store in a cool place away from direct sunlight.

products.name: Velvet Matte Longwear Lip Stain
products.shortDescription: Weightless non-drying liquid lip stain with rich pigment payoff.
products.description: Formulated with nourishing shea butter and jojoba oil to deliver intense, soft-focus matte color that stays comfortable and transfer-resistant throughout your day.
products.label: Bestseller

specifications.Features: Infused with Vitamin E and Jojoba Seed Oil

products.careInstructions: Close cap tightly after each use.
